Your current job has three Proficiencies,
kupo! Each grows through four levels as
you earn higher Clan ranks.

Proficiency I appears on your weapon,
II on your armor, and III on your helmet.
The passives follow your job, not the item.

Apprentice's Writ - ranks 1 to 4.
Journeyman's Writ - ranks 5 to 8.
Master's Writ - ranks 9 to 12, kupo!
